name: Mesh
_comment_chain: Robinhood Chain (Arbitrum Orbit L2, chainId 4663) via a Pons launch — the internal docs repo. deployNetwork picks config/deploy.<network>.json (MESH_DEPLOY_NETWORK overrides; use robinhood-testnet for the rehearsal).
_comment_tradeFeeBps: Pons: 1% base fee (creator keeps 70% of it) + creatorTaxBps 80 (100% to creator) ≈ 1.5% of volume to the creator = us. Informative for the web copy; fees are set at launch on Pons, not here.

requestPricing._comment: Upstream-served requests bill OpenRouter list x (1 - upstreamDiscountBps/10000) or x (1 + upstreamMarkupBps/10000); exactly one may be non-zero. The discount gap is treasury-funded (docs/PRICING.md). Network-served requests bill the flat networkPricePerMTokens.

deposits._comment: Self-serve prepaid top-ups: send USDC/USDG on Robinhood Chain to `receiver`, paste the tx hash on the Market page, the gateway verifies the transfer and credits the balance. Off until receiver + tokens are filled (the dev supplies the stablecoin addresses; receiver = the treasury multisig).

usageShare._comment: Holders earn from paid usage (docs/PRICING.md, engine 2). On from launch: network price 0.08/M, node cost 0.06/M, so 0.02/M of margin of which holderBps joins the hourly pool; frontier requests bill at list (no margin) by design.

starterCredits._comment: First-ever wallet sign-in is credited amountUsd (ledger kind starter) so a developer switching from another gateway can try Mesh before holding. Once per wallet, maxWallets total (0 = unlimited), 3 per IP hash per day. Pause at runtime with POST /admin/starter/toggle.

meta.description: Trading fees buy AI inference for holders, every hour.
